scripts.predev: npm run sync:agents && npm run build -w @assistant/shared
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @assistant/server" "npm run dev -w @assistant/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @assistant/shared && npm run dev -w @assistant/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @assistant/shared && npm run dev -w @assistant/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @assistant/shared && npm run build -w @assistant/server && npm run build -w @assistant/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @assistant/shared && npm run typecheck -w @assistant/server && npm run typecheck -w @assistant/web
